与此同时，网络平台已出现“AI‘仅退款’实战课（售价288元）”“假图二次优化”: At the same time, online platforms have already seen the emergence of paid services such as "AI 'refund only' practical courses (priced at 288 yuan)" and "fake image secondary optimization," claiming "monthly earnings of thousands of yuan per account," with tutorials containing advanced content such as "light and shadow matching techniques" and "multi-angle defect generation."
记者实测了3款主流生成式AI工具，发送了一张桃子照片，输入指令1分钟后，一张表皮: Reporters tested three mainstream generative AI tools by sending a peach photo, and within one minute of inputting instructions, a fake image with the surface covered with brown mold spots of varying shades and partial softening and indentation at the stem was generated — difficult to distinguish from the real thing with the naked eye.
3款生成式AI工具的呈现效果略有不同，但都能达到以假乱真的程度: The three generative AI tools have slightly different presentation effects, but all can achieve a degree of authenticity that deceives the eye.
若想对假图进行细节上的微调，还可以和AI工具再次对话，比如增加果面磕碰痕迹等，工: If one wants to fine-tune details of fake images, one can also engage in further dialogue with the AI tool, such as adding fruit surface collision marks, etc., and the tool can complete the optimization within one minute.
部分软件工具还提供了“电商售后专用模板”，可对AI生成图进行二次光影处理、去除原: Some software tools also provide "e-commerce after-sales exclusive templates" that can perform secondary light and shadow processing on AI-generated images, remove watermarks from original product images, add logistics packaging background elements, and precisely generate fake images conforming to platform review scenarios.
相对于AI生成技术快速发展，检测鉴别技术普及慢、成本高: Relative to the rapid development of AI generation technology, the popularization and deployment of detection and identification technology is slow and costly.
尽管已有AI内容检测工具，但准确率较低，特别是对经过二次处理的深度伪造图像的识别: Although AI content detection tools already exist, their accuracy is relatively low, particularly lacking in the ability to recognize deeply falsified images that have undergone secondary processing.
第三方专业鉴定费用高，远超小额订单金额，多数遭遇AI造假的中小商家觉得不值当，放: Third-party professional authentication fees are high, far exceeding the amount of small orders, and most small and medium-sized merchants affected by AI forgery find it not worthwhile and abandon testing.
AI造假泛滥的背后是平台管理机制滞后，为欺诈行为滋生提供了土壤: Behind the proliferation of AI forgery is the lag in platform management mechanisms, which provides fertile ground for fraudulent activities to breed.

在监管执法方面，建议公安、市场监管、网信等部门协调联动，开展AI技术欺诈专项整治: In terms of regulatory enforcement, it is recommended that public security, market supervision, cyberspace administration and other departments coordinate and cooperate to launch a special campaign against AI technology fraud, investigate and publicly notify a batch of typical cases.
完善法律制度，明确“利用AI伪造证据骗取财物”的行为定性，建立“多次小额欺诈累计: Perfect legal systems and clarify the legal characterization of "using AI to forge evidence to defraud property," and establish a mechanism for "accumulative calculation of multiple small-amount frauds" into criminal conviction.
